scope: Two bounded Kitty Unicode placeholder grid cases in one tab (a 4 x 2 grid of cells over a four-quadrant image: the tile rows, the row marks and the inheritance of a nonzero row; and tiles that scroll, shrink and grow with the text rows that carry them); the run's collection scope says whether that tab is a persistent one or an ordinary one. One 16x16 raw RGBA image, one grid size and one cell font, so every observation is one exact color per cell; independently captured raw replies, paired original offscreen PNGs, complete cells/modes and wall-clock capture spans. Elapsed-time claims are bounded to this App build and run: no display-refresh cadence, other platform, frame-rate, snapshot/persistent-session or stock-grade claim.
